question: Not shared as recorded. P-698 pools single-modality aerobic exercise against non-exercise controls in adults aged 60 or over with MCI. The contested P-699 pool is exergaming against regular activities (mostly traditional physical activity or usual care) on the MMSE in five trials, four in dementia and one in MCI. The intervention (aerobic exercise vs exergaming) and the population behind the pool (MCI vs mostly dementia) differ. P-699 does have an MCI-only global-cognition pool (MoCA, three MCI trials), which is used in the matched-figure check.
metric: Mismatch. P-698: standardised mean difference (Hedges' g) across MMSE, MoCA and NCSE. P-699: raw mean difference in MMSE points (and, separately, in MoCA points).

figures.P-698: Global cognition, aerobic exercise vs control, 11 RCTs, 715 participants: SMD 0.76, 95% CI 0.37-1.14 (abstract; the Results print 0.37-0.91), I2 83%, prediction interval -0.63 to 2.15. Significant benefit.
figures.P-699: MMSE, exergaming vs control, 5 RCTs (1 MCI, 4 dementia): MD 0.95 (95% CI -1.17 to 3.08), P = 0.38, not significant; 2.49 (2.12-2.85) after excluding one heterogeneous trial. MoCA, 3 MCI-only RCTs: MD 2.12 (0.53-3.70), P = 0.009, significant benefit.

matched_figure_check: A matched population figure exists and it reconciles the direction. P-699's MCI-only global-cognition pool (MoCA MD 2.12, 0.53-3.70) shows a significant benefit, as P-698 does. The null MMSE pool is driven by dementia trials. The two metrics (SMD against raw MoCA points) cannot be placed on one interval scale, but on the matched MCI subset both reviews report a significant effect in the same direction.
reason: The recorded opposition is a significant aerobic-exercise SMD in MCI (P-698, 0.76) against a non-significant exergaming MMSE mean difference (P-699, 0.95, -1.17 to 3.08) pooled mainly from dementia trials. Both estimates favour the intervention, so this is a difference in significance only (condition 4), across different interventions, populations and metrics (conditions 1 and 2). P-699's matched MCI-only pool is significantly positive, agreeing in direction with P-698 (condition 3).
